correctness.label: Correctness
correctness.description: Bugs, edge cases, broken contracts, unsafe state, and logic that does not do what it claims.

security.label: Security
security.description: Trust boundaries, injection, authorization, secrets, unsafe deserialization, and data exposure.

performance.label: Performance
performance.description: Hot-path cost, N+1 access, unnecessary work, memory growth, and blocking calls.

database.label: Database
database.description: Schema, migrations, query shape, transactions, indexes, locking, backfills, and data safety.

solid.label: SOLID
solid.description: Single responsibility, open/closed, Liskov substitution, interface segregation, and dependency inversion.

fowler.label: Fowler
fowler.description: Code smells and refactorings from Martin Fowler's Refactoring: long methods, duplication, feature envy, shotgun surgery, and more.

api.label: API & contract
api.description: Public interfaces, backward compatibility, error semantics, versioning, and request/response shape.

testing.label: Testing
testing.description: Coverage of the changed behavior, meaningful assertions, determinism, and missing failure cases.

docs.label: Docs
docs.description: Docs, comments, examples, and contracts that no longer match the code.

style.label: Style
style.description: Readability and local consistency. Use sparingly; formatters and linters own most of this.
